task.title: Make Conversation character statuses feel less repetitive
task.source: User report and deterministic status-generation regression harness
task.classification: Conversation status prompt assembly, repetition detection, and refresh persistence

coreClaim: Conversation character statuses rotate through distinct real-user-like angles, use the character's current routine when available, and do not replace a visible status with a recent near-duplicate.
rootCause: The generator reused one broad prompt shape, over-supplied continuity context, ignored fuzzy character routines, and persisted every provider answer without comparing it to recent statuses.

inScope: Near-duplicate detection and one guarded retry
Provider-loop throttling when both answers repeat
outOfScope: Provider, model, temperature, or connection changes
Shared API, React UI, Rust storage, and remote runtime
A deterministic guarantee that every model response sounds human

claimBoundary.coreClaim: Only Conversation status refreshes rotate six prompt angles, consult current routines, reject recent exact or near-duplicate answers, and throttle a double-rejection without erasing the visible status.
claimBoundary.riskType: prompt compatibility and provider retry behavior
entrypoints: Conversation status refresh with routine-only scheduling data
Conversation status refresh after a repeated provider answer
currentPathsOrFormats: Chat metadata with conversationStatusMessages and optional conversationStatusMessageMeta
Characters with characterRoutines or legacy schedules
Provider answers with or without leading emoji
outOfScopeClaims: No claim that Roleplay or Game status generation changes.
No claim that every provider answer is subjectively unique.
No claim that historical chat metadata is migrated.

contractLaneGate.brokenContract: Conversation status generation had no durable variety state or recent-answer rejection, and its activity lookup did not use the characterRoutines source that current characters expose.
contractLaneGate.producer: src/engine/modes/chat/status/status-message.service.ts assembles status prompts and persists accepted status metadata.
contractLaneGate.consumer: Conversation mode reads conversationStatusMessages as the visible per-character status.
contractLaneGate.impliedContract: The Conversation engine owns both the character context supplied to status generation and the acceptance rules for provider-produced status text.
contractLaneGate.actualEnforcement: The status service chooses a rotating prompt angle, supplies continuity only to its dedicated angle, compares answers against a bounded history, retries once with the next angle, and keeps the prior visible answer after a second rejection.
contractLaneGate.primaryOwnerDetail: Conversation status meaning and prompt assembly remain in src/engine/modes/chat/status.
contractLaneGate.wrongLaneFixToAvoid: Do not hide repeated text in React, alter shared APIs, or push Conversation prompt semantics into storage, providers, or src-tauri.
regressionProof: status-message-variety.spec.ts proves angle rotation, prompt context limits, and duplicate classification.
status-message.service.spec.ts proves routine activity, retry acceptance, and double-rejection throttling.

positiveRows.claim: Successive refresh prompts rotate across six distinct status angles and only the continuity angle receives summaries or memories.
positiveRows.evidence: status-message-variety.spec.ts passes angle rotation and context-isolation rows.

positiveRows.claim: A current characterRoutines entry can ground the status activity even when no legacy schedule exists.
positiveRows.evidence: status-message.service.spec.ts passes the routine-only availability row.

positiveRows.claim: A near-duplicate first answer gets one retry with the next angle and a distinct retry answer is persisted.
positiveRows.evidence: status-message.service.spec.ts passes the guarded retry acceptance row.

contradictionRows.claim: Exact, containment, token-overlap, short phrase, and emoji-prefixed repeats must not replace the visible status.
contradictionRows.evidence: status-message-variety.spec.ts passes exact, Jaccard, containment, short status, and emoji normalization rows.

contradictionRows.claim: A second repeated provider answer must not trigger a 30-second paid-provider loop or erase the prior visible status.
contradictionRows.evidence: status-message.service.spec.ts passes the double-rejection throttle row.

contradictionRows.claim: Distinct short statuses must not be rejected merely because both are brief.
contradictionRows.evidence: status-message-variety.spec.ts passes the distinct short-status negative row.

legacyDefaultRows.claim: Chats without variety metadata start with the first angle and remain readable without a migration.
legacyDefaultRows.evidence: status-message.service.spec.ts baseline and refresh rows pass with legacy metadata shapes.

legacyDefaultRows.claim: Characters that only have legacy schedules retain their existing availability behavior.
legacyDefaultRows.evidence: The existing status-message and schedule service suites remain green.

untestedRows: No live provider long-run sampling is claimed; subjective prose quality remains provider-dependent.
The engine change requires a later De-Koi deployment before it affects the Pi runtime.

ownedFacts.description: Status variety history is bounded to six accepted messages per character.
ownedFacts.evidence: status-message-variety.spec.ts asserts the bounded history contract.

ownedFacts.description: Typing evidence influences style only and is not represented as a factual activity claim.
ownedFacts.evidence: status-message-variety.spec.ts asserts the typing cue wording and prompt boundary.

ownedFacts.description: A rejected retry advances refresh timing and the next angle while retaining the previous visible status.
ownedFacts.evidence: status-message.service.spec.ts asserts visible-status preservation and refresh throttling.

manualBlockers.reason: Deterministic prompt selection, routine grounding, persistence, retry, and rejection contracts are locally covered; subjective wording remains model-dependent.

verification.baselineEvidence: pnpm check passed TypeScript, architecture, security, storage contracts, docs, discovery, workflow safety, Rust workspace checks, and the repository's warning-only unused-code inventory.
edgeRowsTested: Exact, containment, Jaccard, short phrase, and emoji-prefixed repeats
negativeRowsTested: No continuity context outside the continuity angle
No visible-status replacement after a rejected retry
No Roleplay or Game path change

checks.bunnyReviewStatus: passed locally with no actionable findings
